text: There must've been a time when that attendant was learning the safety demo for the first time. And there's a lot to remember. Seatbelt.
The flight is basically an escape room.
She would've practiced the shit out of it.
Which means at some point, she was alone in her room… standing in front of a mirror… practising the safety demo.
And she must've been excited to perform for her first flight. She might've even fantasised—
I'll do it so well, the entire flight will give me a standing ovation.
And then she finally does it… and there's a baby crying in 14B…
and the entire flight is hooked to the baby. She's performing in front of 180 people—and she's bombing.
I come here every week and bomb.
At least she has a baby crying in 14B. I'm competing with every baby on the internet.
